svg.text: Lloyd is the cheap floor: at equal work it trails Lloyd→DA by 0.5–3.2 points here, and builds the tree in 14 s, not 223 s.

svg.text: and the last stretch of the curve — for about ten times the build time. That is the whole trade, stated as a number.
